evidence.detail: The class extends RGBImageFilter and stores a reference BufferedImage plus constructor-supplied source and target Colors.

For each coordinate it reads the reference-image pixel, compares all three channels against the source Color through Sprite's tolerance helper, and when matched shifts the channels by the source-to-target color delta while preserving alpha and clamping channels to 0..255.
R55 Sprite constructs this filter exclusively in its static BufferedImage+sourceColor+targetColor transform helper, wraps it in FilteredImageSource and returns the filtered Image.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for Sprite's tolerance-based source-to-target recolor RGBImageFilter.

evidence.detail: The class extends RGBImageFilter and stores one constructor-supplied Color plus that color's opaque RGB value.
filterRGB compares each pixel to the chosen opaque RGB key; exact matches return the same 24-bit RGB with the alpha byte removed, while non-matching pixels are returned unchanged.
R55 Sprite constructs this filter exclusively in its static Image+Color transform helper, wraps it in FilteredImageSource and returns the Toolkit-created filtered Image.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for Sprite's one-color transparency-key RGBImageFilter.
